core: Edit target: the supplied Ancient Empires II J2ME interface icon reference sheet. Identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Make a production high-definition faithful remaster SPRITE SHEET, exactly 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 24 isolated icons in original row-major order. Keep every icon in its same cell, center each at (column+.5,row+.5) normalized cell position, generous transparent gutter, no labels, no letters, no grid lines or background. Actual transparent RGBA background. Clean sharp hand-painted 2D fantasy game inventory art with restrained detail, bold readable silhouettes and subtly beveled edges; retains original nostalgic design, shape, orientation, colors and meaning. NO redesign or new objects. Row1: diagonal steel sword GOLD hilt RED jewel pointing upper-left; diagonal green leaf pointing upper-left; cyan-white four-point magical star in blue diamond; grey castle gate with two towers and narrow red/gold banner; brown golden-handled magnifying glass; green turquoise globe. Row2: red closed book gold bands/red bookmark; WHITE speech bubble THREE DARK DOTS; grey gravestone rounded top and horizontal engraved lines; pink diagonal leaf upper-left; golden dollar symbol; golden HOUSE silhouette. Row3: gold diagonal SWORD silhouette rising upper-right; gold PLUS; gold four-direction arrows; gold DOWN arrow; gold HASH #; short steel sword red/gold hilt lower-left rising upper-right. Row4: grey shield bright pink inset; gold CHEVRON rank badge shaped like reference; ivory HOURGLASS; single gold COIN; red/pink poison DROP; pale BLUE square with brilliant white four-point blessing star. Last two must retain red poison vs blue blessing distinction. Gold action symbols remain simple gold symbols, not ornate medallions. Grey metal and green/red/blue colors close to reference. All 24 symbols are full and distinct, absolutely no missing/duplicate cells, no text except shape of dollar and hash. Preserve all empty negative spaces/holes in hash/dollar/house. Highest crisp edges, no blur/pixelated blocks, no realistic photography. Remove reference dark background and labels. Output sheet aspect 3:2, ideally 1536x1024.
controls: Edit target: supplied Ancient Empires II J2ME UI controls reference sheet. Make a faithful high-definition remaster sprite sheet in EXACTLY SIX equal columns and SIX equal rows (36 equal cells). 34 sprites in same row-major cells as reference, cells35/36 EMPTY transparent. True RGBA transparent background, no labels, no text, no grid. Each sprite centered in its own cell with transparent gutters. Sharp 2D fantasy game UI, bold nostalgic silhouettes, restrained polished silver bevels and fine shading, never replace the symbol with something else. Match reference colors/orientations. Row1: silver UP triangle; silver DOWN triangle; ivory STAR; green UP arrow; pink DOWN arrow; gold CHECKMARK. Row2: gold curved LEFT/back arrow; gold DOUBLE RIGHT chevron; gold DOWN triangle; silver LEFT triangle; silver RIGHT triangle; silver circular button rim with opaque dark navy inset. Row3: matching silver circular button rim with ivory inset selected; smaller silver ring with black/dark inset; matching smaller silver ring with pink inset selected; four detached hot-pink L corners with fully transparent CENTER; another four hot-pink L corners same shape; hot-pink circular target outline with four small spikes and fully transparent center. Row4: slightly rotated hot-pink target outline four spikes transparent center; another rotated matching target outline; hot-pink X endpoint marker; silver GRAVESTONE rounded top engraved horizontal lines; silver rim SMALL ROUND team marker BLUE inset; identical silver rim marker RED/PINK inset. Row5: identical silver rim marker GREEN inset; identical silver rim marker DARK BLUE inset; silver beveled PANEL TOP LEFT CORNER with dark square corner ornament and transparent open lower right; straight SILVER HORIZONTAL TOP EDGE; silver TOP RIGHT CORNER transparent open lower left; silver VERTICAL LEFT EDGE. Row6: silver VERTICAL RIGHT EDGE; silver BOTTOM LEFT CORNER transparent open upper right; silver horizontal BOTTOM EDGE; silver BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER transparent open upper left; EMPTY; EMPTY. These eight last panel border fragments must stay SIMPLE continuous straight silver strips like originals, uniform thickness, no vines/ornaments, same square inset at four corners. Empty area around border strips must be TRANSPARENT not opaque rectangles. Pink cursors stay hollow, do not add fill/glow in center. Team markers are SAME shape with only inset color differences. Grey rims/black outline original aesthetic, no new symbols. Preserve every sprite count/orientation and the reference relative shapes. Output square sheet ideally1536x1536 with6x6grid.
